تحتسبن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَسِبْنَ (taḥtasibna) /taħ.ta.sib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# تُحْتَسَبْنَ (tuḥtasabna) /tuħ.ta.sab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
